description: Last Bushfire and Prescribed Burn Boundaries is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Environment and Water. The dataset provides most recent fire scar mapping for many major fires that have burnt in a given area within or adjacent to National Parks and Wildlife South Australia (NPWSA) reserves. This data set is derived from Fire History mapping. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Environment and Water. Its tags are bushfire, fire, fire incidents, natural hazards. It offers 4 resource(s) in geojson, html, kmz, shp. The portal shows 2020-02-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
